before.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass creates sections.
before.reason: The old harness calls read_begin before the assembly pass, and before-source read_begin initializes notes.

after.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass creates sections now that read_begin no longer does so.
after.reason: After-source initializes notes in main, which the harness bypasses. Its call to read_begin initializes only cond_obstack before the pass creates sections.

claims.reason: The same harness call sequence satisfied initialization before the change through read_begin. After the change, that sequence omits the initialization because its new site is main.
